purpose: SS-01: the player's M1 sheet at option B. kindled-ash in the Ash Remembrance, every M1 animation of the Kindled table, from ART's 45 px exemplar, as a draft G1.2 recipe (art/sheets/kindled-ash.json).
images_passed_as: upload:<id> reference from get_upload_url; no inline base64 anywhere
seed: create_character and animate_character take no seed parameter

upload.check: the uploaded file is byte-identical to the blob committed at HEAD (same sha256); the upload API returns no hash and cannot be read back, but the returned south rotation equals the exemplar on every pixel (0 differing pixels)

arguments.description: Ash, a small Kindled clay figure about 45 px tall with grey-ochre clay skin and three amber freckles, in a soot-grey hooded cloak with an ember-singed hem over a grey tunic with a gold collar trim, an iron-grey belt and boots, dark trousers; a short hooked steel blade with a brown leather grip in the right hand. Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a low three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark navy outline, no dithering, transparent background.
arguments.name: kindled-ash (ss01)

character.files: rotation/<direction>.png from the rotation URLs, byte-identical to the character zip
character.blade_hand_check: S, SE, E, NE, SW: blade in the right hand. W: the blade is drawn in front of the body in the near hand, so the rotation has mirrored it into the LEFT hand (W reads as E flipped). NW and N: the blade is hidden behind the body (the right hand is the far hand); the visible NW hand is empty. Not a retake, as the job says.

walk.note: queued while 3 idle jobs still ran, to keep at most 8 at once

dodge.action_description: a quick forward roll: crouches low, tucks into a tight ball and rolls forward, then springs back up to stand

light_1.action_description: a quick horizontal slash with the short hooked blade in the right hand, from the right side across to the left, then back to guard

light_2.action_description: a quick backhand slash with the short hooked blade in the right hand, from the left side back across to the right, then back to guard

dodge (retake).action_description: a quick forward roll: crouches low, tucks into a tight ball and rolls forward head over heels, then springs back up to stand
dodge (retake).note: the identical description was matched to take 1 and not re-queued ('an identical request is matched to the existing clip, not charged again'), so 'head over heels' was added; nothing else changed

light_3.action_description: a heavy downward chop with the short hooked blade in the right hand, from above the shoulder down to the ground, ending crouched low

heavy.action_description: draws the short hooked blade back low behind the hip and holds it, crouched, then thrusts it straight forward at full arm's length, holds the thrust, then pulls back to guard

haul.action_description: throws the right arm straight forward as if casting a chain, holds the arm out, then pulls the arm back to the chest

haul_pull.action_description: plants both feet, leans back and pulls hard with both hands on a rope in front, two strong pulls

heavy (retake).action_description: draws the short hooked blade back low behind the hip and holds it, crouched, then thrusts it straight forward at full arm's length, holds the thrust, then pulls back to guard, without turning around
heavy (retake).note: ', without turning around' added: an identical request is matched to the existing clip and not re-queued

haul_slide.action_description: dragged forward on planted feet, leaning back against the pull, cloak streaming back

retakes.reason: wrong action: in take 1 no facing rolls; the figure crouches, lunges and stands (N and NW spread the arms; W turns the blade into an orange ball in frames 5-8, S into a pale blob in 3-7).
retakes.change: the identical description was deduplicated by PixelLab ('an identical request is matched to the existing clip, not charged again'), so 'head over heels' was added
retakes.result: W, SW and NW now tumble in frames 5-7; S, SE, E, N and NE still crouch and rise without rolling (failed twice there). NE and N of the retake carry reserved colours in nearly every frame, so the recipe takes NE and N from take 1.

retakes.reason: wrong facing and a redesigned face: from frame 6 the N figure turns round to face the viewer with teal eyes and a dark mask, so its thrust, hold and recover are unusable.
retakes.change: ', without turning around' added (identical text is deduplicated)
retakes.result: the facing holds, but frames 8-9 are smears and every frame except 6 carries spark-glow #FFE7A3 pixels, so it gives no usable thrust; the recipe takes heavy_charge N frames 2-4 from take 1 (before the turn) and leaves N out of thrust, hold and recover.

balance.note: 1566.90 - 1516.90 = 50 = idle 24 + walk 24 + dodge part 1 2; dodge part 2 not yet charged

balance.when: after idle, walk, dodge + retake, light_1-3, heavy, haul 4/8 (before the last two calls were charged)
balance.note: 1567.90 - 1466.90 = 101 = create 1 + idle 24 + walk 24 + dodge 8 + dodge retake 8 + light_1 8 + light_2 8 + light_3 8 + heavy 8 + haul 4

balance.when: end of generation (all animations and both retakes)
balance.note: 1567.90 - 1421.90 = 146.00 = create 1 + idle 24 + walk 24 + dodge 8 + dodge retake 8 + light_1 8 + light_2 8 + light_3 8 + heavy 8 + heavy retake N 1 + haul 8 + haul_pull 8 + haul_slide 8 + hit 12 + death 12

downloads.when: after the dodge retake, light_2/3, heavy
downloads.result: 516 files in art/raw (8 rotations + all frames) byte-identical to the character zip; 16 directions taken from the zip because they had not been fetched by URL
687 files in art/raw/ss01-kindled-ash (8 rotations + 679 frames) byte-identical to the final character zip (688 entries = 687 PNGs + metadata.json, saved as character-metadata.json)

downloads.note: frames were fetched from the per-direction URLs that get_character lists as soon as each direction finished, and three character zips were fetched whenever the queue was empty; every file present in both is byte-identical. The zip names the retakes dodge_retake and heavy_retake_N; on disk they are dodge/ (the dodge retake, used by the recipe), dodge-take1/ (take 1) and heavy-retake/north.

frame_layout: v3 output: frame-0 is the rotation (keep_first_frame default true), frames 1..n generated, on a 68x68 canvas. skeleton-v3 output (idle, walk on 80x80; hit, death on 80x80): no rotation frame, its own frame 0 is the reference. breathing-idle has 4 frames, walking-6-frames 6, taking-punch 6, falling-back-death 7.
other_jobs_seen: wait_for_jobs once reported job b27e1e3b-4c1e-4789-8680-5abefd663dfa (an animation) completing; it is not one of this job's calls.

reserved_colour_frames.note: source frames with pixels whose nearest of the 32 tokens (OKLab) is signal-hit #FFFFFF, spark-glow #FFE7A3 or the telegraph pair; the pipeline fails on these (step 4), so the recipe never picks them. Format: frame:{nearest reserved token: pixels}.
